children.name: essential-systems.css
children.content: .mb-essential{--mb-primary:#087f96;--mb-primary-dark:#075f72;--mb-primary-soft:#eaf6f8;--mb-purple:#76509b;--mb-orange:#d68033;--mb-red:#ca5252;--mb-green:#4f8650;--mb-blue:#267c91;--mb-ink:#1b2935;--mb-muted:#66737e;--mb-line:#dfe7eb;--mb-surface:#fff;--mb-background:#f4f7f8;min-height:calc(100vh - 64px);padding:20px 16px 32px;background:var(--mb-background);color:var(--mb-ink);font-family:"Noto Sans",Arial,sans-serif}.mb-essential *{box-sizing:border-box}.mb-essential__hero{position:relative;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;min-height:130px;max-width:1600px;margin:0 auto 22px;padding:30px 40px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:14px;color:#fff;background:linear-gradient(105deg,#07839b 0%,#3a9cac 58%,#b6dce2 100%);box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(7,95,114,.18)}.mb-essential__hero h1{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:clamp(30px,4vw,44px);line-height:1.08;letter-spacing:-.03em}.mb-essential__hero p{margin:0}.mb-essential__hero-mark{position:absolute;right:35px;top:18px;width:210px;height:110px;opacity:.3}.mb-essential__hero-mark span{position:absolute;display:block;border:2px solid #fff;border-radius:999px}.mb-essential__hero-mark span:nth-child(1){width:155px;height:155px;right:-15px;top:-65px}.mb-essential__hero-mark span:nth-child(2){width:105px;height:105px;right:20px;top:-30px}.mb-essential__hero-mark span:nth-child(3){width:56px;height:56px;right:50px;top:8px}.mb-essential__panel{max-width:1600px;margin:0 auto;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid var(--mb-line);border-radius:18px;background:var(--mb-surface);box-shadow:0 16px 38px rgba(24,58,72,.1)}.mb-essential__table-wrap{overflow:auto}.mb-essential__table-wrap:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(8,127,150,.32);outline-offset:-3px}.mb-essential__table{width:100%;min-width:1680px;border-collapse:separate;border-spacing:0}.mb-essential__table th,.mb-essential__table td{padding:13px 10px;border-right:1px solid #edf1f3;border-bottom:1px solid var(--mb-line);vertical-align:middle}.mb-essential__table th:last-child,.mb-essential__table td:last-child{border-right:0}.mb-essential__table thead th{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:2;background:#f6eef9;color:#352540;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;text-align:center}.mb-essential__head-main th{height:54px}.mb-essential__head-sub th{top:54px;height:52px}.mb-essential__table tbody tr:hover{background:#f8fcfd}.mb-essential__table tbody tr:last-child td{border-bottom:0}.mb-essential__category{width:118px;text-align:center}.mb-essential__category-badge{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-width:95px;padding:9px 12px;border:1px solid #c9e5eb;border-radius:999px;background:#edf8fa;color:#14758a;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}.mb-essential__product{min-width:220px;font-weight:800}.mb-essential__center{text-align:center}.mb-essential__segment{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:25px;height:25px;border:1px solid #c4e4ea;border-radius:50%;background:#edf8fa;color:#117d93;font-weight:900}.mb-essential__area{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:7px 12px;border:1px solid #cde4e9;border-radius:999px;background:#f6fbfc;color:#1c7286;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.06em;text-transform:uppercase;white-space:nowrap}.mb-essential__dash{color:#7b858d;font-weight:700}.mb-essential__resource{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:36px;height:36px;border:0;border-radius:50%;color:#fff;text-decoration:none;box-shadow:0 3px 10px rgba(22,45,58,.22);transition:transform .15s ease,filter .15s ease}.mb-essential__resource:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);filter:brightness(.94)}.mb-essential__resource:focus-visible{outline:3px solid rgba(8,127,150,.35);outline-offset:3px}.mb-essential__resource svg{width:18px;height:18px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}.mb-essential__resource--quotation{background:var(--mb-blue)}.mb-essential__resource--brochure{background:var(--mb-purple)}.mb-essential__resource--presentation{background:var(--mb-orange)}.mb-essential__resource--video{background:var(--mb-red)}.mb-essential__resource--demo{background:#337f75}.mb-essential__resource--website{background:var(--mb-green)}.mb-essential__empty{padding:32px;text-align:center;color:var(--mb-muted)}.mb-essential__footer{max-width:1600px;margin:12px auto 0;padding:0 4px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:16px;color:#606b73;font-size:13px}.mb-essential__footer a{color:inherit;text-decoration:underline}.mb-essential__translations{display:none}@media(max-width:760px){.mb-essential{padding:12px 8px 24px}.mb-essential__hero{min-height:115px;padding:24px 20px}.mb-essential__hero-mark{right:-45px}.mb-essential__footer{align-items:flex-start;flex-direction:column;gap:5px}}@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.mb-essential__resource{transition:none}}
